items.title: Scaling Laws for Multilingual Neural Machine Translation
items.summary: We study how model size and training data affect translation quality across 30 languages, and derive scaling exponents for both dimensions.

items.title: Efficient Agent Tool Use via Latent Plan Compression
items.summary: A method to compress agent plans into latent codes, reducing API calls and improving response time for tool-augmented LLMs.

items.title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet gets new long-context and coding features
items.summary: Anthropic expands context window and improves code generation; API and Claude.ai updated.

items.title: Diffusion Models with Structured Latent State for 3D Scene Synthesis
items.summary: We introduce a diffusion model that operates on a structured scene graph latent, enabling controllable 3D scene generation.

items.title: Open-source LLM inference benchmarks: vLLM vs SGLang
items.summary: Community benchmark compares throughput and latency for popular inference servers on A100 and H100.
